crossRefs.note: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by…
My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

parallels.note: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.

translations.web: You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped.
translations.bsb: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
translations.kjv: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.
translations.asv: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; And my feet have not slipped.
